eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 3:01 PM on AUG 27, 2025 Effective until 1:01 AM AUG 28, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A Silver Alert has been issued for Mesa Police Department. Mesa Police Department is looking for a Hispanic male, Ascencion Olea-Torres, 85 years-old, 5 foot 6 inches, 140 lbs., white hair with brown eyes. Ascension was last seen wearing a white short sleeved shirt, black pants, white socks, and prescription glasses. He left on foot from the area of Main Street and Alma School Road in Mesa, Arizona, Maricopa County today. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
